verdicts.reason: A: the headline and subhead sit flush against the leaf image with no gutter. The logo and the jar are shrunk to tiny chips crammed along the bottom edge beside the CTA. The legal text floats in a separate column far to the right with a dead gap, but the left text column at least shares one clean left edge. B is worse: the headline is indented away from the eyebrow and subhead, so the left edge is ragged. 'calmer' almost touches the legal column, the CTA overlaps the bottom corner of the image, and the CTA, jar and logo sit on different baselines, so the bottom row reads as scattered.
